args.answer: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock
args.reasoning:
The group composition that satisfies all constraints:
- Death Knight (Frost DPS, Plate, uses ice abilities)
- Hunter (DPS, Mail, has bear pet)
- Paladin (Protection Tank, Plate, uses holy spells)
- Priest (Holy Healer, Cloth, uses holy spells)
- Warlock (Destruction/Demonology DPS, Cloth, uses Metamorphosis and fire abilities)

This gives: 2 plate wearers (Death Knight, Paladin), 2 cloth wearers (Priest, Warlock), 1 mail wearer (Hunter). Tank and healer both cast holy spells. Ice (Death Knight) and fire (Warlock) are used by different DPS. A bear (Hunter's pet) attacks the boss. Metamorphosis is cast by Warlock. No leather wearers, so no one can use the leather Kilt of the Forgotten One.
